title: 1 Pa. Code § 3.3. Periodic supplementation of Code ; index.
text:
§ 3.3. Periodic supplementation of Code ; index.
(a) At least once a year documents required to be codified in the Code by § 3.1 (relating to contents of Code ) which have been filed in the Bureau shall be permanently integrated into the Code by the publication and distribution of looseleaf pages relating to the affected portion of the Code , or if ordered by the Joint Committee, by the issue or reissue of an appropriate title of the Code or designated portion thereof.
(b) Section 726 of 45 Pa.C.S. (relating to permanent supplements of Pennsylvania Code ) requires that at least once a year the index to the Code shall be similarly supplemented or reissued.
(c) At least once a year a tabular listing of the statutory authority cited in the Code as authority for the promulgation of documents shall be issued, supplemented or reissued.
Cross References
This section cited in 1 Pa. Code § 3.31 (relating to publication of official synopsis in lieu of full text); 1 Pa. Code § 9.301 (relating to unpublished statements of policy adopted prior to January 1, 1985); and 1 Pa. Code § 13.5 (relating to deposit of management directives).
